description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Lex Model Building Service API, including method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, and retrieving bot versions, intents, slot types, and other Lex resources. It also contains PHPDoc annotations documenting the available methods and their asynchronous counterparts.

methods.name: createBotVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing Amazon Lex bot.

methods.name: createIntentVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing intent.

methods.name: createSlotTypeVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing slot type.

methods.name: deleteBot
methods.description: Deletes a specified bot.

methods.name: deleteBotAlias
methods.description: Deletes an alias for a bot.

methods.name: deleteBotChannelAssociation
methods.description: Deletes the association between a bot and a channel.

methods.name: deleteBotVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specified version of a bot.

methods.name: deleteIntent
methods.description: Deletes the specified intent.

methods.name: deleteIntentVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of an intent.

methods.name: deleteSlotType
methods.description: Deletes the specified slot type.

methods.name: deleteSlotTypeVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of a slot type.

methods.name: deleteUtterances
methods.description: Deletes user utterances.

methods.name: getBot
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific bot.

methods.name: getBotAlias
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific alias.

methods.name: getBotAliases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all aliases for a bot.

methods.name: getBotChannelAssociation
methods.description: Gets information about the association between a bot and a channel.

methods.name: getBotChannelAssociations
methods.description: Gets a list of all channel associations for a bot.

methods.name: getBotVersions
methods.description: Retrieves bot versions.

methods.name: getBots
methods.description: Lists all bots.

methods.name: getBuiltinIntent
methods.description: Returns information about a built-in intent.

methods.name: getBuiltinIntents
methods.description: Returns a list of built-in intents.

methods.name: getBuiltinSlotTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of built-in slot types.

methods.name: getExport
methods.description: Gets information about an export.

methods.name: getImport
methods.description: Gets information about an import.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific intent.

methods.name: getIntentVersions
methods.description: Retrieves different versions of an intent.

methods.name: getIntents
methods.description: Gets a list of intents.

methods.name: getMigration
methods.description: Retrieves information about a migration.

methods.name: getMigrations
methods.description: Lists all migrations.

methods.name: getSlotType
methods.description: Gets a specific slot type.

methods.name: getSlotTypeVersions
methods.description: Retrieves versions of a slot type.

methods.name: getSlotTypes
methods.description: Lists slot types.

methods.name: getUtterancesView
methods.description: Views utterances.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: putBot
methods.description: Creates or updates a bot.

methods.name: putBotAlias
methods.description: Creates or updates a bot alias.

methods.name: putIntent
methods.description: Creates or updates an intent.

methods.name: putSlotType
methods.description: Creates or updates a slot type.

methods.name: startImport
methods.description: Starts an import job.

methods.name: startMigration
methods.description: Starts a migration.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.
